Explanation: The variable `root` is assigned at line 3. At line 11, `root` is passed as an argument to `getUnrootedName`, whose return value is then passed to `mapper.map` to produce `name`. At line 13, `name` is used to construct `file`. Since `file` at line 25 is the same object created at line 13, its value depends on `name`, which in turn depends on `root`. Therefore, the value of `file` at line 25 depends on the value of `root` at line 3.
